headline: Advance Booking for Architecture and River Activities
reservation: Fallingwater requires timed-entry reservations months in advance through the Western Pennsylvania Conservancy. Pennsylvania State Parks manage camping and cabin bookings via a central system; holiday weekends reach capacity early. Always verify tour availability before arriving at historic sites.

days.title: Waterfalls and Rail Trails

stops.name: Cucumber Falls
stops.detail: Visit this 30-foot drop via a short descent from the parking area near the Youghiogheny River.

stops.name: Great Allegheny Passage
stops.detail: Walk or cycle a flat section of this former rail corridor for river views and forest scenery.

days.driving: Walking or short local transfers within Ohiopyle; allow for weekend congestion.
days.note: Waterfall steps are often wet and slippery; use handrails where provided.

days.title: Mountain Ridges and Bogs

stops.name: Laurel Summit State Park
stops.detail: Walk the boardwalk at Spruce Flats Bog to see unique high-altitude wetland plants.

stops.name: Laurel Highlands Hiking Trail
stops.detail: Experience a segment of the 70-mile ridge trail for expansive forest views and rocky terrain.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 hours for ridge road travel; conditions vary on narrow mountain routes.
days.note: Spruce Flats Bog is a sensitive environment; stay strictly on the designated boardwalk.

days.title: Architectural Icons and History

stops.name: Fallingwater
stops.detail: Tour Frank Lloyd Wright’s masterpiece built over Bear Run, noting specific tour requirements and age limits.

stops.name: Fort Necessity National Battlefield
stops.detail: Explore the site of the opening action of the French and Indian War and the nearby visitor center.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour total for travel between Mill Run and Farmington.
days.note: Reserve architecture tours well in advance; photography rules vary by tour type.

intel.title: Ohiopyle Congestion
intel.text: Central Ohiopyle parking fills rapidly on summer Saturdays. Arrive early or visit during weekdays to ensure access to falls viewing areas.

intel.title: Remote Ridge Gaps
intel.text: Mobile coverage is non-existent in deep river valleys and parts of Laurel Ridge. Download regional maps and attraction directions before leaving Ligonier.

intel.title: Gateway Supplies
intel.text: Fuel services are concentrated in Ligonier, Somerset, and Uniontown. Monitor levels before traversing the forested corridors of Route 381.

intel.title: Seasonal Water Flow
intel.text: Waterfall volume at Cucumber Falls varies with rainfall; peak flow is common in spring but not guaranteed. Check local gauges for rafting conditions.

intel.title: Trail Surfaces
intel.text: The Great Allegheny Passage is crushed stone, while the Laurel Highlands Hiking Trail is rugged and rocky. Match footwear to the specific trail type.

plan.arrival: Pickup rental at Arnold Palmer Regional Airport, stock supplies in Ligonier, and check-in to regional lodging or cabins.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for main roads; check rental terms for driving on unpaved state forest access routes.
plan.goldenHour: Youghiogheny River Overlook, subject to morning fog and seasonal foliage density.
